# garage_cluster_status (Data Source)

Nodes of the cluster, connected or not, with their role and disk space. Use it to find the node IDs for `garage_cluster_layout`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_status" "this" {}

output "node_ids" {
  value = { for n in data.garage_cluster_status.this.nodes : n.hostname => n.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `layout_version` (Number)
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
